<!-- Generated by make site-ref (scripts/sitegen) from wdx itself: do not edit. -->

With `--json`, nothing prompts and stdout holds exactly one JSON object and nothing else, the same the daemon's API returns. The flags that answer a command's questions are then required up front.

```text
  success: {"result": "created", "project": {...}}
  failure: Problem Details (RFC 9457):
           {"type": "urn:wdx:error:not_found", "title": "...", "status": 404,
            "detail": "...", "code": "not_found", "hint": "...",
            "details": {...}, "debug_id": "dbg-..."}
```

"result" names what happened; commands that change nothing have none. Keys are snake\_case, absent values null and timestamps RFC 3339. Each command's help lists its results and error codes, and wdx &lt;command&gt; `--help` `--json` prints the help itself as JSON.
